subject.title: Bound trajectory pointer file read with size cap

question: Should the trajectory-pointer bounded-read change be consolidated into the broader open PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110516, or should this focused PR remain the single landing path?
rationale: Both open branches claim the same source-level change, but neither currently supplies sufficient real behavior proof and the supplied diff for this PR still has a concrete decoding defect.

options.title: Consolidate into the broader PR
options.body: Keep the trajectory change only in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110516 after correcting it and adding proof for the pointer-file path.

options.title: Retain this focused PR
options.body: Remove the overlapping trajectory change from the broader PR, correct this branch’s buffer decoding, and provide the required runtime evidence here.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into the broader PR
recommendation.body: Keep the trajectory change only in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110516 after correcting it and adding proof for the pointer-file path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both overlapping branches and the related merged bounded-read work.
